description: PR auto-approve policy for the cal.diy repo. Enforced by .claude/scripts/check-pr-approve.sh via a PreToolUse hook, and runnable directly through the pr-auto-approve-check skill.
rule: Auto-approve a PR only when every changed file is non-code (docs, copy/content strings, config, etc.). If any changed file matches codeExtensions, the PR must be reviewed manually.
